Characterization of Gate Dielectrics ALD Al O was deposited using a commercial ALD system Cambridge Savannah 2 3 with the following conditions: TMA pulse 15ms/purge 4s, H O pulse 1ms/purge 4s, 2 260°C deposition temperature and no post deposition annealing. The average breakdown electric field of 3.3MV/cm and a record high of 6.7MV/cm were measured. CV hysteresis was 0.59V (Fig.1). Time dependent stress test in which the MIS capacitors were held in 4V for different time durations showed a series of consistent hysteresis of ~0.1V (Fig.2). Voltage dependent stress test in which the MIS capacitors were held in different positive voltages for 10mins showed a series of consistent hysteresis of ~0.15V (Fig.3). PEALD Al O was deposited using self-built PEALD system in Dr. Nemamich’s 2 3 group from the Arizona State University with the following conditions: pretreatment with H /N plasma at 680°C, 200°C deposition temperature and post deposition annealing 2 2 with N at 400°C for 15min. The average breakdown electric field of 3.6MV/cm and a 2 record high of 8.9MV/cm were measured. CV hysteresis was 0.41V (Fig.4). Time dependent stress test showed a series of consistent hysteresis of ~0.04V (Fig.3).
